title: Senior Mobile Architect
raw_text: This position leads mobile architecture and engineering strategy at a scaled technology company with mobile apps serving over 100 million users across iOS and Android platforms. The senior mobile architect will own the long-term vision and roadmap for mobile platform infrastructure, lead a team of eight to twelve mobile engineers across multiple squads, and make critical architectural decisions that impact the entire mobile ecosystem. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing modular architecture systems using Swift Package Manager and Gradle modules, establishing best practices and coding standards across iOS and Android teams, mentoring senior and junior engineers through code reviews and technical workshops, and collaborating with platform engineers and infrastructure teams on CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies. The engineer will also evaluate and adopt emerging technologies such as SwiftUI async/await patterns and Kotlin Coroutines, lead major migration initiatives such as transitioning codebases between architectural paradigms, and present technical decisions to engineering leadership. The required technical stack includes deep expertise in Swift and Kotlin, hands-on familiarity with advanced iOS and Android frameworks, mastery of state management patterns at scale, and professional experience with testing frameworks including XCTest and Espresso. Additional requirements include proven experience leading engineering teams, successful track record of shipping major platform migrations, proficiency with CI/CD systems like Jenkins and Xcode Server, and experience managing complex dependencies using SPM and Gradle. Success in the first six months involves establishing a clear mobile platform roadmap validated with stakeholder input, identifying and initiating one major technical improvement initiative that measurably improves developer velocity or app performance, and earning trust from both engineering and product leadership through clear communication. This role collaborates with senior engineers across iOS and Android squads, platform and infrastructure teams, product leadership, and VP-level executives on quarterly planning. The position offers significant scope for impact, leading technical direction for the entire mobile organization and mentoring the next generation of senior mobile engineers.
